fields.label: Image Overlay Strength (%)
fields.description: Higher values keep text easier to read over the image.

fields.label: Themes Available to Users
fields.description: Leave empty to offer all 11 themes. System Managers can always use every theme.

fields.label: Sidebar
fields.description: Each theme keeps its own sidebar style. Edit the row of the theme you want to change.

fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Falls back to the app logo from Website Settings.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Headline of the login designs (Classic design: the card title). Arabic version below.

fields.label: Subtitle
fields.description: Sub-headline (English). Arabic version below.

fields.label: Login Designer
fields.description: Choose and tune the login page. 'Native Frappe Login' (or adding ?native=1 to the URL) always gives the untouched Frappe page.

fields.label: Login Design
fields.options:
Match Organization Theme
Fiori Blue
Redwood Purple
Emerald Modern
Midnight Pro
Sandstone Premium
Ocean Breeze
Sunset Fusion
Forest Harmony
Royal Indigo
Modern Teal
Carbon Pro
Classic (Theme Login)
Native Frappe Login
fields.description: Keep 'Match Organization Theme' so the login page always looks like the selected theme. Pick a specific design only if you want the login page to stay fixed whatever the theme.

fields.label: Login Follows Last Theme Used in This Browser
fields.description: With 'Match Organization Theme': a browser that has signed in before sees the login page of the theme that user chose; new browsers see the organization theme. Only the theme name is remembered (cookie).

fields.label: Login Page Language
fields.description: Language shown to visitors who have not chosen one yet. The language switcher on the page overrides it.

fields.label: Login Card Position
fields.description: Start/End follow the reading direction (Arabic mirrors).

fields.options:
Theme Default

fields.label: Glass Transparency (%)
fields.description: 50 = design default; lower = clearer glass, higher = more solid.

fields.label: Feature Cards
fields.description: Up to 3 are shown. Leave empty for the default cards.

fields.label: Live Preview
fields.description: Shows the login page with the values above, before you save.

fields.label: Custom CSS
fields.description: Appended after the theme. Use the --uts-* variables where possible.
